title: PostgreSQL ignores index for leading-wildcard LIKE '%term%'
cause: B-tree indexes cannot efficiently support leading-wildcard pattern matches.
solution: Use trigram indexes (pg_trgm) for substring search, full-text search for natural language, or search services when scale demands. Avoid wrapping indexed columns in functions that defeat index use.
workaround: Prefix search `term%` when product-acceptable; add LIMIT and stricter filters.
